anchor_gloss: middle voice of a primary verb; to "will," i.e. (reflexively) be willing:--be disposed, minded, intend, list, (be, of own) will (-ing). Compare θέλω. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (גָּלִיל); Galilæa (i.e. the heathen circle), a region of Palestine:--Galilee. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary particle; properly, assigning a reason (used in argument, explanation or intensification; often with other particles):--and, as, because (that), but, even, for, indeed, no doubt, seeing, then, therefore, verily, what, why, yet. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of uncertain derivation; the stomach; by analogy, the matrix; figuratively, a gourmand:--belly, + with child, womb. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from the same as γενεά; nativity; figuratively, nature:--generation, nature(-ral). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from a variation of γένος; to procreate (properly, of the father, but by extension of the mother); figuratively, to regenerate:--bear, beget, be born, bring forth, conceive, be delivered of, gender, make, spring. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from γεννάω; nativity:--birth. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from γεννάω; born:--they that are born. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

contracted from a primary word; soil; by extension a region, or the solid part or the whole of the terrene globe (including the occupants in each application):--country, earth(-ly), ground, land, world. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
akin to γέρων; senility:--old age. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a prolongation and middle voice form of a primary verb; to cause to be ("gen"-erate), i.e. (reflexively) to become (come into being), used with great latitude (literal, figurative, intensive, etc.):--arise, be assembled, be(-come, -fall, -have self), be brought (to pass), (be) come (to pass), continue, be divided, draw, be ended, fall, be finished, follow, be found, be fulfilled, + God forbid, grow, happen, have, be kept, be made, be married, be ordained to be, partake, pass, be performed, be published, require, seem, be showed, X soon as it was, sound, be taken, be turned, use, wax, will, would, be wrought. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a prolonged form of a primary verb; to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed):--allow, be aware (of), feel, (have) know(-ledge), perceived, be resolved, can speak, be sure, understand. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (אַבְרָהָם); Abraham, the Hebrew patriarch:--Abraham. (In Acts 7:16 the text should probably read Jacob.) [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from γινώσκω; well-known:--acquaintance, (which may be) known, notable. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of uncertain derivation; to grumble:--murmur. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from the base of γίνομαι; a parent:--parent. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
a primary verb; to "grave", especially to write; figuratively, to describe:--describe, write(-ing, -ten). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
probably from the base of γίνομαι; a woman; specially, a wife:--wife, woman. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (דָּוִד); Dabid (i.e. David), the Israelite king:--David. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
a primary particle (adversative or continuative); but, and, etc.:--also, and, but, moreover, now (often unexpressed in English). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from δέομαι; a petition:--prayer, request, supplication. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

3rd person singular active present of δέω; also deon deh-on'; neuter active participle of the same; both used impersonally; it is (was, etc.) necessary (as binding):--behoved, be meet, must (needs), (be) need(-ful), ought, should. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
feminine of δέκατος; a tenth, i.e. as a percentage or (technically) tithe:--tenth (part), tithe. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from δεκάτη; to tithe, i.e. to give or take a tenth:--pay (receive) tithes. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from δεσμόν; a captive (as bound):--in bonds, prisoner. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from δεσμόν and φύλαξ; a jailer (as guarding the prisoners):--jailor, keeper of the prison. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
as the comparative of δύο; (ordinal) second (in time, place, or rank; also adverb):--afterward, again, second(-arily, time). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary preposition denoting the channel of an act; through (in very wide applications, local, causal, or occasional):--after, always, among, at, to avoid, because of (that), briefly, by, for (cause) … fore, from, in, by occasion of, of, by reason of, for sake, that, thereby, therefore, X though, through(-out), to, wherefore, with (-in). In composition it retains the same general importance. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of uncertain derivation; Ægyptus, the land of the Nile:--Egypt. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

of uncertain derivation; blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred:--blood. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from διά and τηρέω; to watch thoroughly, i.e. (positively and transitively) to observe strictly, or (negatively and reflexively) to avoid wholly:--keep. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses); to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection):--adventure, bestow, bring forth, commit, deliver (up), give, grant, hinder, make, minister, number, offer, have power, put, receive, set, shew, smite (+ with the hand), strike (+ with the palm of the hand), suffer, take, utter, yield. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from διά and ἐγείρω; to wake fully; i.e. arouse (literally or figuratively):--arise, awake, raise, stir up. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from δίκη; equitable (in character or act); by implication, innocent, holy (absolutely or relatively):--just, meet, right(-eous). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from διά and ὅς; through which thing, i.e. consequently:--for which cause, therefore, wherefore. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from διά and ὅτι; on the very account that, or inasmuch as:--because (that), for, therefore. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of uncertain affinity; to be able or possible:--be able, can (do, + -not), could, may, might, be possible, be of power. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from δύναμαι; force (literally or figuratively); specially, miraculous power (usually by implication, a miracle itself):--ability, abundance, meaning, might(-ily, -y, -y deed), (worker of) miracle(-s), power, strength, violence, mighty (wonderful) work. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from δῶρον; a gratuity:--gift. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive case (dative case or accusative case) of αὐτός; him- (her-, it-, them-, also (in conjunction with the personal pronoun of the other persons) my-, thy-, our-, your-) self (selves), etc.:--alone, her (own, -self), (he) himself, his (own), itself, one (to) another, our (thine) own(-selves), + that she had, their (own, own selves), (of) them(-selves), they, thyself, you, your (own, own conceits, own selves, -selves). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

probably akin to the base of ἀγορά (through the idea of collecting one's faculties); to waken (transitively or intransitively), i.e. rouse (literally, from sleep, from sitting or lying, from disease, from death; or figuratively, from obscurity, inactivity, ruins, nonexistence):--awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-)rise (again, up), stand, take up. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἐν and the base of κῦμα; swelling inside, i.e. pregnant:--great with child. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary pronoun of the first person I (only expressed when emphatic):--I, me. For the other cases and the plural see ἐμέ, ἐμοί, ἐμοῦ, ἡμᾶς, ἡμεῖς, ἡμῖν, ἡμῶν, etc. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἔθος; to accustom, i.e. (neuter passive participle) customary:--custom. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary particle of conditionality; if, whether, that, etc.:--forasmuch as, if, that, (al-)though, whether. Often used in connection or composition with other particles, especially as in εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μή(γε), εἰ καί, εἰ μή, εἰ μή τι, εἴ περ, εἴ πως, εἴ τις, ἐκ. See also ἐάν. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from εἴδω; a view, i.e. form (literally or figuratively):--appearance, fashion, shape, sight. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary verb; used only in certain past tenses, the others being borrowed from the equivalent ὀπτάνομαι and ὁράω; properly, to see (literally or figuratively); by implication, (in the perfect tense only) to know:--be aware, behold, X can (+ not tell), consider, (have) know(-ledge), look (on), perceive, see, be sure, tell, understand, wish, wot. Compare ὀπτάνομαι. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

the first person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb; I exist (used only when emphatic):--am, have been, X it is I, was. See also εἶ, εἴην, εἶναι, εἰσί, ἦν, ἔσομαι, ἐσμέν, ἐστέ, ἐστί, κέρδος, ἴσθι, ὦ. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary preposition; to or into (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases:--(abundant-)ly, against, among, as, at, (back-)ward, before, by, concerning, + continual, + far more exceeding, for (intent, purpose), fore, + forth, in (among, at, unto, -so much that, -to), to the intent that, + of one mind, + never, of, (up-)on, + perish, + set at one again, (so) that, therefore(-unto), throughout, til, to (be, the end, -ward), (here-)until(-to), …ward, (where-)fore, with. Often used in composition with the same general import, but only with verbs (etc.) expressing motion (literally or figuratively). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary numeral; one:--a(-n, -ny, certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some. See also εἷς καθ’ εἷς, μηδείς, μία, οὐδείς. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from εἰς and ἄγω; to introduce (literally or figuratively):--bring in(-to), (+ was to) lead into. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from εἰς and ἀκούω; to listen to:--hear. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from εἰς and ἔρχομαι; to enter (literally or figuratively):--X arise, come (in, into), enter in(-to), go in (through). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or motion proceeds), from, out (of place, time, or cause; literal or figurative; direct or remote):--after, among, X are, at, betwixt(-yond), by (the means of), exceedingly, (+ abundantly above), for(- th), from (among, forth, up), + grudgingly, + heartily, X heavenly, X hereby, + very highly, in, …ly, (because, by reason) of, off (from), on, out among (from, of), over, since, X thenceforth, through, X unto, X vehemently, with(-out). Often used in composition, with the same general import; often of completion. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of uncertain affinity; there; by extension, thither:--there, thither(-ward), (to) yonder (place). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from ἐκεῖ; that one (or (neuter) thing); often intensified by the article prefixed:--he, it, the other (same), selfsame, that (same, very), X their, X them, they, this, those. See also οὗτος. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἐκ and πληρόω; to accomplish entirely:--fulfill. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἐκ and πλήσσω; to strike with astonishment:--amaze, astonish. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from ἐκ and πορεύομαι; to depart, be discharged, proceed, project:--come (forth, out of), depart, go (forth, out), issue, proceed (out of). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
ordinal from ἕξ; sixth:--sixth. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἐκ and φέρω; to bear out (literally or figuratively):--bear, bring forth, carry forth (out). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἐκ and φεύγω; to flee out:--escape, flee. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (אֱלִישֶׁבַע); Elisabet, an Israelitess:--Elisabeth. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (עִמָּנוּאֵל); God with us; Emmanuel, a name of Christ:--Emmanuel. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or constructively), i.e. a relation of rest (intermediate between εἰς and ἐκ); "in," at, (up-)on, by, etc.:--about, after, against, + almost, X altogether, among, X as, at, before, between, (here-)by (+ all means), for (… sake of), + give self wholly to, (here-)in(-to, -wardly), X mightily, (because) of, (up-)on, (open-)ly, X outwardly, one, X quickly, X shortly, (speedi-)ly, X that, X there(-in, -on), through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), under, when, where(-with), while, with(-in). Often used in compounds, with substantially the same import; rarely with verbs of motion, and then not to indicate direction, except (elliptically) by a separate (and different) preposition. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from ἐν and δύνω (in the sense of sinking into a garment); to invest with clothing (literally or figuratively):--array, clothe (with), endue, have (put) on. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from a compound of ἐν and θυμός; to be inspirited, i.e. ponder:--think. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἐν and νεύω; to nod at, i.e. beckon or communicate by gesture:--make signs. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἐντέλλομαι; injunction, i.e. an authoritative prescription:--commandment, precept. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἐκ and ἀποστέλλω; to send away forth, i.e. (on a mission) to despatch, or (peremptorily) to dismiss:--send (away, forth, out). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from ἐκ and ἔρχομαι; to issue (literally or figuratively):--come (forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἐκ and ὕπνος; awake:--X out of sleep. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
adverb from ἐκ; out(-side, of doors), literally or figuratively:--away, forth, (with-)out (of, -ward), strange. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of uncertain affinity; a festival:--feast, holyday. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἐπαγγέλλω; an announcement (for information, assent or pledge; especially a divine assurance of good):--message, promise. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from ἐπί and εἰ; thereupon, i.e. since (of time or cause):--because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἐπί and ἔρχομαι; to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence:--come (in, upon). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary preposition; properly, meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc.:--about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, X have charge of, (be-, (where-))fore, in (a place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-)on (behalf of), over, (by, for) the space of, through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), with. In compounds it retains essentially the same import, at, upon, etc. (literally or figuratively). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary verb; to hear (in various senses):--give (in the) audience (of), come (to the ears), (shall) hear(-er, -ken), be noised, be reported, understand. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἀκρατής; want of self-restraint:--excess, incontinency. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from ἐπί and a derivative of σκιά; to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest with preternatural influence:--overshadow. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (אַהֲרוֹן); Aaron, the brother of Moses:--Aaron. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from ἔπω; a word:--X say. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
probably a fuller form of ῥέω; an alternate for ἔπω in certain tenses; to utter, i.e. speak or say:--call, say, speak (of), tell. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

middle voice of a primary verb  (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being  supplied by a kindred (middle voice)               ,    or (active)        ,        which do not otherwise occur); to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and  figuratively):--accompany, appear, bring, come, enter, fall out, go, grow, X light, X next, pass, resort, be set. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (חֶצְרוֹן); Esrom (i.e. Chetsron), an Israelite:--Esrom. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a superlative probably from ἔχω (in the sense of contiguity); farthest, final (of place or time):--ends of, last, latter end, lowest, uttermost. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

perhaps akin to ἔτος; "yet," still (of time or degree):--after that, also, ever, (any) further, (t-)henceforth (more), hereafter, (any) longer, (any) more(-one), now, still, yet. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
apparently a primary word; a year:--year. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from the same as εὐαγγελίζω; a good message, i.e. the gospel:--gospel. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from εὖ and δοκέω; to think well of, i.e. approve (an act); specially, to approbate (a person or thing):--think good, (be well) please(-d), be the good (have, take) pleasure, be willing. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from a compound of εὖ and λόγος; to speak well of, i.e. (religiously) to bless (thank or invoke a benediction upon, prosper):--bless, praise. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a prolonged form of a primary               ,      which                                 (together with another cognate form)                   is used for it in all the tenses                                except the present and imperfect; to find (literally or figuratively):--find, get, obtain, perceive, see. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from Ἔφεσος; an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus:--Ephesian, of Ephesus. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from ἐφήμερος; diurnality, i.e. (specially) the quotidian rotation or class of the Jewish priests' service at the Temple, as distributed by families:--course. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary verb; to hold (used in very various applications, literally or figuratively, direct or remote; such as possession; ability, contiuity, relation, or condition):--be (able, X hold, possessed with), accompany, + begin to amend, can(+ -not), X conceive, count, diseased, do + eat, + enjoy, + fear, following, have, hold, keep, + lack, + go to law, lie, + must needs, + of necessity, + need, next, + recover, + reign, + rest, + return, X sick, take for, + tremble, + uncircumcised, use. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

of uncertain affinity; a conjunction, preposition and adverb of continuance, until (of time and place):--even (until, unto), (as) far (as), how long, (un-)til(-l), (hither-, un-, up) to, while(-s). [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (זֶרַח); Zara, (i.e. Zerach), an Israelite:--Zara. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (זְכַרְיָה); Zacharias (i.e. Zechariah), the name of two Israelites:--Zacharias. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

of uncertain affinity; to seek (literally or figuratively); specially, (by Hebraism) to worship (God), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against life):--be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X will) seek (after, for, means). Compare πυνθάνομαι. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (זְרֻבָּבֶל); Zorobabel (i.e. Zerubbabel), an Israelite:--Zorobabel. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

a primary particle of distinction between two connected terms; disjunctive, or; comparative, than:--and, but (either), (n-)either, except it be, (n-)or (else), rather, save, than, that, what, yea. Often used in connection with other particles. Compare especially ἤδη, ἤπερ, ἤτοι. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (עֵלִי); Heli (i.e. Eli), an Israelite:--Heli. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

feminine (with ὥρα implied) of a derivative of  (to sit; akin to the base of ἑδραῖος) meaning tame, i.e. gentle; day, i.e. (literally) the time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several days were usually reckoned by the Jews as inclusive of the parts of both extremes); figuratively, a period (always defined more or less clearly by the context):--age, + alway, (mid-)day (by day, (-ly)), + for ever, judgment, (day) time, while, years. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
compound of  (a "hero") and εἶδος; heroic; Herod, the name of four Jewish kings:--Herod. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
of Hebrew origin (תָּמָר); Thamar (i.e. Tamar), an Israelitess:--Thamar. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
from θαῦμα; to wonder; by implication, to admire:--admire, have in admiration, marvel, wonder. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]

from the prolonged form of θέλω; a determination (properly, the thing), i.e. (actively) choice (specially, purpose, decree; abstractly, volition) or (passively) inclination:-- desire, pleasure, will. [source: MetaV Strongs.csv <- openscriptures/strongs CC BY-SA]
